criteria.criterion: Restore artifacts are hash-bound and verifiably readable.
criteria.primary_evidence: All 41 manifest-referenced hashes matched; both database backups returned quick_check=ok and integrity_check=ok with manifest counts; scheduled-task XML was 3346-byte UTF-16LE with BOM and passed strict XmlReader parsing; the source ZIP was readable and contained all 397 baseline paths. However, the restore directory contains four additional unmanifested artifacts: live-foundry-r0.db-shm (32768 bytes), live-foundry-r0.db-wal (0 bytes), isolated-v7-r0.db-shm (32768 bytes), and isolated-v7-r0.db-wal (0 bytes). The actual restore-set contents are therefore not fully manifest-bound. Additionally, 391 of 397 ZIP file bytes did not reproduce their Git blob IDs because export-time text conversion occurred; the manifest does not disclose or bind that transformation.

criteria.criterion: No live or protected state was changed.

findings.reproduction: Enumerate every file under var/remaster/r0/restore and compare its absolute path with every manifest object containing path and sha256. Ten files exist in the directory, but only six restore-root files are represented.
findings.repair: Preserve this FAIL; add the defect to FINDINGS.jsonl; generate a fresh restore unit whose directory contains only declared artifacts, or explicitly declare and hash every required sidecar. Validate frozen backups without producing mutable SHM/WAL residue, freeze the new manifest and scope hashes, then dispatch a fresh verifier.

findings.finding: The ZIP is path-complete but not byte-exact to the recorded baseline Git tree because export-time text conversion changed 391 of 397 blob identities.
findings.reproduction: Read every ZIP entry, calculate its Git blob ID as SHA1('blob ' + byte_length + NUL + bytes), and compare against git ls-tree -r 93a3ddc. The ZIP has 397 files and no missing/extra paths, but only six file blobs match exactly.
findings.repair: Either replace it with a byte-exact Git restore artifact such as a verified bundle/object-preserving archive, or explicitly document and deterministically verify the export-attribute transformation with a per-entry hash manifest. Add the limitation to FINDINGS.jsonl.
